"Managed Service for Apache Spark" is the new name for the product formerly known as "Dataproc on Compute Engine" (cluster deployment) and "Google Cloud Serverless for Apache Spark" (serverless deployment).

#  Managed Service for Apache Spark templates Stay organized with collections  Save and categorize content based on your preferences. 

The Managed Service for Apache Spark templates are open source, not an official or supported Google product. The template code is located in the [GoogleCloudPlatform/templates](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/dataproc-templates) GitHub repository.

Use Managed Service for Apache Spark templates to quickly set up and run common Spark batch workloads without writing code.

## Managed Service for Apache Spark templates

The following Managed Service for Apache Spark templates are Java templates. See the GitHub [GoogleCloudPlatform/templates/python](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/dataproc-templates/tree/main/python) repository for Python templates and the [GoogleCloudPlatform/templates/notebook](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/dataproc-templates/tree/main/notebooks) repository for Python templates in Jupyter notebooks. 

You can run following Managed Service for Apache Spark templates using the gcloud CLI or API:

  * [Cloud Spanner to Cloud Storage](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/spanner-to-storage)
  * [Cloud Storage to BigQuery](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/storage-to-bigquery)
  * [Cloud Storage to Cloud Spanner](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/storage-to-spanner)
  * [Cloud Storage to Cloud Storage](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/storage-to-storage)
  * [Cloud Storage to JDBC](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/storage-to-jdbc)
  * [Hive to BigQuery](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/hive-to-bigquery)
  * [Hive to Cloud Storage](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/hive-to-storage)
  * [JDBC to BigQuery](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/jdbc-to-bigquery)
  * [JDBC to Cloud Spanner](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/jdbc-to-spanner)
  * [JDBC to Cloud Storage](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/jdbc-to-storage)
  * [JDBC to JDBC](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/jdbc-to-jdbc)
  * [Pub/Sub to Cloud Storage](https://docs.cloud.google.com/managed-spark/docs/templates/pubsub-to-storage)

**Note:** Additional Managed Service for Apache Spark templates are available in the GitHub [GoogleCloudPlatform/templates](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/dataproc-templates) repository.
